origin: Independent implementation. No upstream source lines were copied; behaviour was matched to the engine semantics listed below and checked with synthetic round trips.

references.use: Line dispatch (JavaScript trim, ';' '#' '*' '@' '_' prefixes, whole-line /* */ comments), bracket nesting, literal brackets while iscript is open, quoted-attribute handling that drops ASCII spaces and maps '#' to '=', speaker lookup through jname -> character key, and the .tpatch location/apply behaviour for Electron builds.

Archive layout: 16-byte Chromium pickle prefix, JSON directory tree with decimal-string offsets relative to the data region, unpacked members stored beside the archive, and per-file SHA256 integrity blocks.

deviations: Header JSON, member ranges, names and overlaps are bounds-checked before any member is read.
With no replacement the rebuilt archive is byte-identical; with replacements only sizes, later offsets and integrity records change.
Text inside iscript, html and macro blocks is never exported; unreferenced scenario files are reported and excluded by default.
